title: NBN maintenance – Kew POI (3KEW), VIC
current_summary: Planned NBN maintenance at the Kew POI (3KEW), VIC is scheduled for 6 October 2026 from 3:00am to 6:00am AEDT. Services delivered via this POI may be interrupted during the window (up to 3 hours).
